summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of YouTube Karaoke collaborative web app. All backend API endpoints and frontend features tested successfully. Backend: YouTube search API proxy working correctly with validation and pagination. Frontend: All 3 pages (Buscar, Lista compartida, Reproductor) working perfectly with real-time Firebase sync, role-based access control, player controls, and mobile responsiveness.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/youtube/search with valid query returns 200 with items array (video_id, title, thumbnail, channel_title) and nextPageToken
Backend: GET /api/youtube/search with empty/missing q returns 422 validation error
Backend: GET /api/youtube/search pagination with pageToken works correctly
Frontend: Search page loads with input and submit button
Frontend: Search functionality returns results in search-results-grid
Frontend: 'Añadir' button adds video to playlist and shows 'Añadido' state
Frontend: 'Vista previa' button opens preview-dialog with 15s countdown
Frontend: Navigate to /lista shows shared-playlist-list with real-time Firebase sync
Frontend: 'Eliminar' button on /lista removes items from playlist
Frontend: Role guard - non-admin users cannot access /reproductor (redirected to /)
Frontend: nav-reproductor link hidden for non-admin users
Frontend: Login dialog opens with header-login-button
Frontend: Entering 'admin123' in login-code-input grants admin role
Frontend: Role badge changes to 'Admin' after successful login
Frontend: nav-reproductor link appears for admin users
Frontend: Wrong admin code shows error toast and maintains user role
Frontend: Admin can access /reproductor page
Frontend: Player page loads with player-controls-bar, player-queue-list, and player-enter-button
Frontend: All player controls exist: player-controls-playpause-button, player-controls-next-button, player-controls-progress-slider, player-controls-volume-slider
Frontend: Fullscreen mode works - player-fullscreen-enter-button shows fullscreen, player-fullscreen-exit-button exits
Frontend: Admin role persists across page reload (localStorage)
Frontend: Logout with header-logout-button returns to user role and redirects to /
Frontend: Mobile responsive - mobile-menu-button shows navigation links
Frontend: Mobile search and add to playlist functionality works
